unittest2 1.1.0 manual license notice

The unittest2 1.1.0 source distribution does not include a standalone
LICENSE file. Its setup.py states:

  This software is licensed under the terms of the BSD license.
  http://www.voidspace.org.uk/python/license.shtml

Its PKG-INFO metadata includes:

  Classifier: License :: OSI Approved :: BSD License

Source distribution used for this review:

  https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/u/unittest2/unittest2-1.1.0.tar.gz
